data.title: 艾莉莎 · 把旗结收紧一点
data.description: 岸边的游泳区刚开放，浮标绳却被浪推到警示杆下。艾莉莎蹲下来，接住从杆上落下的蓝旗，把两条旗角重新系紧。白罩衫正好挡住一阵海风，她扭头看了眼浪的方向。
data.action: 在警示杆边半蹲，双手系好旗结
data.lighting: 侧面阳光照亮木板和旗面
data.promptProse: Alya crouches on the wooden swimming pier to tighten the knot on a small blue safety flag. The white linen cover-up shifts in the wind, and the cold blue edging of her swimsuit echoes the water behind the rail. The flag fabric and both hands are visible from the side.
data.animaCaption: Both hands hold the loose corners of the safety flag as the end of the knot lifts in the wind.
